scope: Sanitized aggregate evidence for the R9 episode-entry/layout investigation. No user timestamps, session identifiers, content, raw hierarchy, or original diagnostic is included.

playback_observers.interpretation: Every recorded observer invocation returned. These are host notifications, not actual video-frame progress, decoder state, or measured playback rate.

patch_presentation.interpretation: The trace confirms the R8 forwarding path was selected; it is emitted before the host call and cannot prove that every native presentation or callback completed.

scene_evidence.mask_scene_context: Personal profile page, based on the recorded view classes and role map.
scene_evidence.export_snapshot_context: Settings-related hierarchy, inferred from settings-open events and view classes.

observations: The uploaded plugin identity is Honggo R8 even though the user message names FanqkeX.
Four distinct process startup sequences are present. The diagnostic does not distinguish manual termination, a crash, or an ordinary restart.
The R8 playback observers show no recorded call left between enter and return, and all recorded finish gates declined interception.
Some sessions end after pause/state activity, but there is no episode-entry tap or navigation trace establishing the reported action time.

code_risks_addressed_separately_from_log.risk: R8 restores and reapplies render transforms during repeated layout, which can invalidate native layout even when the desired result is unchanged.
R8 episode material updates repeatedly write geometry and reorder a decoration to subview index zero; circular action material also resizes to owner bounds before shrinking to its final rectangle.
R8 does not explicitly restore owned render geometry before same-window superview transfer into a native detail container.

uncertainties: No thread backtrace, watchdog report, crash report, or actual frozen player hierarchy is supplied.
No direct watch-all-episodes action, native detail transition, or player transfer event is recorded.
A tall video and enabled glass do not establish that the independent player.fullscreen setting was enabled; the glass preset leaves it disabled by default.
Observed playback notifications do not measure frames, network readiness, decoder state, progress, or actual speed.
The log does not uniquely establish the hang cause. The layout and transfer changes remain a candidate fix until verified in the real host on a device.
Controlled UIKit transition regressions and successful compilation cannot substitute for real Hongguo device acceptance.
